# Third-party build tools (not shipped with the game)

| Folder | What | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `building_tools/` | Building Tools 1.0.13, Blender add-on by Ian Karanja (ranjian0): floorplans, floors, windows, doors, balconies, stairs, roofs. CityForge's house catalogue (`tools/cityforge/houses.py`) drives it headless. | MIT (`building_tools/LICENSE`) | https://github.com/ranjian0/building_tools |

They run only inside the Blender build scripts. The generated meshes are ours; the add-on code is
not part of the exported game.
